lifecycle.creation_reason: Proven by MT-074 remediation with runtime evidence: seven of its thirteen canonical receipts terminalize indeterminate because the targets expose no product-side completion predicate. MT-074 is proof-only and structurally cannot fix it. Captured here per the Operator standing rule that a discovered gap outside the current MT is deferred to a future MT in the same work packet rather than lost.

scope.summary: Add durable product-side completion observers for the Stage embed-back, rich-document save, and Calendar event/activity actions so their canonical Argus receipts terminalize applied instead of indeterminate.

evidence_this_is_real.source: MT-074 artifacts at source_sha a2e8ec7417f4, verified directly by KERNEL_BUILDER.
indeterminate_actions: OP-01 stage-embed-back / OP-04 stage-embed-back (Stage, MT-066 surface)
OP-02 open-calendar-event / OP-04 calendar-open-event (Calendar, MT-067 surface)
OP-02 open-calendar-activity / OP-04 calendar-open-activity (Calendar, MT-067 surface)
evidence_this_is_real.contrast_proving_the_fix_shape: In the SAME matrix the Locus chip receipts terminalize APPLIED, because MT-068 built a durable shell-owned observer for them. The Stage and Calendar targets have no equivalent. The fix shape is therefore already proven in this WP.
evidence_this_is_real.product_fallback: mcp/action.rs emits "click was dispatched, but this target exposes no action-specific completion predicate" for these targets.

acceptance_criteria: AC-117-1: each named action publishes a DURABLE completion observer on the EXISTING handshake.click-completion/v1 mechanism - the shape MT-024/026/028/029/042/064/065/068/079 already prove. Do NOT invent a second mechanism.

AC-117-2: each observer publishes Applied ONLY on the authoritative durable effect (the persisted artifact id + sha256 for embed-back; the advanced doc_version for save; the exact bound CalendarEvent id and the exact ActivitySpan/document correlation for Calendar), and publishes a TYPED rejection on a bounded window rather than hanging Pending.
AC-117-3: canonical_argus_driver.rs is NOT modified and finish() is NOT weakened.

AC-117-4: re-running MT-074 test_other_pillar_interop_proofs shows those receipts terminalizing APPLIED, with the suite still green. The strict gate finish_require_no_indeterminate() should then be reachable for those scenarios.
AC-117-5: the observers are proof-only in effect - the product must behave identically with no Argus binding open.
proof_targets: PT-117-1: MT-074 suite re-run showing 13/13 receipts applied and zero indeterminate.
PT-117-2: the MT-066 and MT-067 suites still green (these are their surfaces).
PT-117-3: a bounded-window typed rejection proven for at least one observer, so an unreached effect cannot hang Pending.

hbr_obligations.VIS: Frames must be OPENED and inspected; reject byte-identical before/after pairs (a known failure mode in this WP).
hbr_obligations.MAN: Update the internal manual if the documented completion posture for these actions changes.
